༄༅/ /kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul bzhugs/na mo bai ro tsa na ye/'dir kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul mdor bsdus zhig gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul bzhugs/na mo bai ro tsa na ye/ 'dir kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul mdor bsdus zhig gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas brjod par bya ste/ 'di'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa ni/ rgyud don gsal ba rtsa 'grel sogs las bshad pa ltar yin la/ de yang rdor dril byin brlab nas bsnyen pa'i bar dang*/ de nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i bar ste/ 'di la bla med ltar thun bzhi so so la mngon rtogs bskyed tshul re byed mi dgos kyi/ thun dang po la bskyed zin pa des chog go /'o na kyang slar bskyed 'dod na ni byas chog la/ bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ rtsa rig gam/ gtso bo'i sngags sam/ me tog phog pa'i lha gang rung gi sngags 'bum dang*/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re'o/ /grub na ye shes 'bebs sngags 'bum mam khri dang*/ sbyin sreg kyang bya'o/ /thun mtshams byed par 'dod na/ yig brgya'i mjug tu mchod bstod byas rjes/ rang nyid gtso bo las logs su bye ste/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug slar thun gnyis pa sogs 'jug pa na nye reg byas te/ gtso bo'i dam rgya bcings nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥgatso bo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus re byas nas bsnyen pa la 'jug cing thun phyi ma'i mthar mchod la bstod do/ /slar yang yig brgya bzlas nas bzod gsol bsdus ba byas te/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ zhes pa nas/ gzir las sgrol/ ces brjod cing*/ mchod yon phul rjes/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces pa'i tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa badz+ra muḥbadag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdam tshig pa'i rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsdus te rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam la/

rdor sems su gyur pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sogs gzhung ltar bya ba dang*/ smon lam dang shis brjod rgyas bsdus ni skabs dang bstun chog kha cig mchod yod phul rjes sarba bid ces gtso bo'i dam rgya bkrol bar mdzad kyang cho ga sogs nas ni snga ma ltar 'byung ngo*/ /spyir gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ rang bdag 'jug sogs byed pa rnams la'ang bsnyen pa de ltar dgos shing*/ bsnyen pa ma byas par de rnams la zhugs na nyes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yin mod/ da lta ni kun rig gi phyag len phyogs kun tu khyab kyang*/ bsnyen tshad rdzogs pa lta zhog /dbang zhus nas bsnyen pa'i phyogs mthun tsam byed mkhan yang dkon par mthong ngo*/ /dbang bsnyen med par gzhan don du dmigs nas lha khyad par can 'di rnams kyi sgom bzlas dang mtshan nas brjod pa dang mchod bstod sogs byas na ni gzhan la phan thogs kyang bsnyen pa'i phyogs tsam zhig ma byas par gzhan don du chog la 'jug pa'i gtso bo byed na ni/ rang la nyes pa che bas bsnyen pa dgos so/ /gal te gong ltar ma grub na/ cung zad bsdus pa'am/ shin tu bsdus pa'i bsnyen pa zhig nges par bya dgos shing de la 'bring dang bsdus pa tsam ni/ khro bo spyan 'dren bsdus pa'am 'jog pa gang rung dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdaum gzung kyang bzhag chog /'khor gy-i lha bskyed pa'i tshul paṇa chen rin po che'i kun rig gi cho ga ltar lha rnams kyi sa bon thams cad gsang 'dus bzhin rim gyis bskyed de de las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang de rnams yongs su gyur pa lha rnams su bskyed pa ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i lha dang mgron thabs kyi lha'i sde tshan so sor bya zhing de man chad gzhung ltar dang*/ spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ 'phrin las dang mchod bstod la'ang rgyas bsdus gnyis so/ /de yang ma grub na/ dang po sbyor ba byas nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs pa nas gtso bo'i bstod pa dang*/

de'i bsnyen pa 'bum byas rjes/ rang gtso bor gsal ba'i mdun du skad cig gis dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams dmigs nas mchod bstod kyi mthar rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi bsnyen grangs rdzogs par byar rung bar sngags rim sogs kyi dgongs par mngon te/ sngags rim du sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lung drangs nas/ tha na snying bo'i don gyis rang sangs rgyas kyi skur bsgyur te/ mdun du yang sangs rgyas kyi sku tshig tsam gyis bsgom zhing zhes pa nas/ de tsam yang khyad che bas gson po dang gshin po la dbang bskur ba dang rab gnas sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgo nas byed pa rnams kyis tha na'ang sgom pa de tsam re byas nas rang rang gi bzlas pa rdzogs pa re bya dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang gtso bo'am/ me tog phog pa'i lha gang rung zhig gi bsnyen pa bya ba ste/ 'dir gtso bo'i dbang du byas na gzhal khang bskyed mi bskyed gnyis dang*/ bskyed pa la'ang phyi nang gi gzhal yas khang gnyis ka byed mi byed pa'i lugs gnyis las/ mi byed pa ni don la gnas so/ /gzhal yas khang mi bskyed na/ thog mar rdor dril byin rlabs sogs grub na'ang legs shing*/ grub ma grub gang ltar yang*/ shū n+ya ta'i sngags brjod nas stong ba'i ngang las aṃ siṃ aṃ las seṅge'i khri'i steng du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ zhes pa nas/ mi snang bar gyur to zhes pa'i bar ram/ rgyab yol mnga' ba zhes pa'i bar gang rung*/ de nas/ rang gi spy-i bor oṃ dkar bo nas hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad la sangs rgyas dang byang chung sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥm lus sems can nas 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā ka ru ṇi sogs dang*/

bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa lags/ zhes pa nas/ gtso bo'i dam rgya bcings nas snying po dang sngags gsum re brjod de/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga ba nas ngo bos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi lkog mar hrīḥnas dzī ho/ oṃ sarba bid sogs gtso bo'i sngags tsam dang*/ rdo rje'i lte ba la rang gi sngags ky-is mtshan par gyur/ gar dang glu dang nas las kyi phyag rgya dbang du gyur/ sarba bid/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/ sarba bid/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga bas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ bud dha a bhi sogs kyis dbang bskur nas/ gtso bo'i 'phrin las tsam bcol/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'am/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ar+ghaṃ sogs sam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ shap+ta'i bar dang sgeg sogs brgyad kyis kyang mchod de/ mnyam med mi g.yo zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gam/ chos dbyings ye shes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod/ 'di de sangs rgyas sogs brjod dam min kyang rung la rang gi thugs kar bzlas pa'i sngags nas 'od zer can dang zhal gyi sngags kyi sgra byung bar gyur ces brjod/ gtso bo'i bsnyen pa 'bum bya zhing rtsa rigs kyang ci 'grub bzla'o/ /'bum song rjes tshogs zhing zur du gsal ba ltar byas la/ lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags ci 'grub dang*/ yig brgya bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su lha gsar du bskyed mi dgos pas/ sngar bskyed zin dran pa tsam byas nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /'dir lha thams cad kyi bsnyen grangs rdzogs pa ni nyin zhag bco lnga'i skor las mi 'gor zhing*/ gtso bo'i bsnyen grangs 'bum dang lha gzhan rnams dang rtsa rig ci 'grub byed pa la ni bdun gcig las lhag mi dgos par snang bas 'di tsam la ni le lo mi byed par 'bad par mdzod cig/'on kyang cho gar rtsa rig dang me tog phog pa'i lha'i sngags gang rung 'bum bzla bar bshad nas/

gtso bo'i sngags bzla ba dngos su mi gsal yang don gyis de gsum 'dam nga can du bstan la/ ṭīka chen nas gtso bo'i sngags dang me tog phog pa'i lha'i sngags gnyis 'dam nga can du gsal bar bshad cing*/ yon tan bshes gnyen gyi ṭīka chung dang*/ rje yab sras kyi slob ma gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs gnyis kar yang rtsa rig dang gtso bo'i sngags dang me tog phog pa'i lha'i sngags gsum po gang rung 'dam nga can du bshad do/ rtsa rig rab yin kyang*/ gtso bo'i sngags dang*/ me tog phog pa'i lha'i sngags gang rung 'bum bzlas kyang 'grub pa ni/ khungs de gnyis su ma zad cho ga gzhan gyi bsnyen pa'i rigs 'gros kyis kyang shes so/ /bsnyen pa'i bdag bskyed kyi bsdu rim gong gi de ltar yin par gzhung du gsal zhing*/ spyir bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu bsdu rim kyang des go mod/ 'di ltar bya ba cho ga'i gzhung las mi gsal ba'i rkyen gyis/ da lta phyag len du cho ga rdzogs pa'i mjug tu bum lha dang lhan cig dam rgya bkrol nas ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'i tshul dar ro/ /'on kyang gsang ba de gnyis la sogs ba'i cho ga gzhan gyi rigs 'gros sbyar na 'di'i cho ga'i gzhung ltar bdag bskyed zin pa'i mjug de ma thag tu dam rgya bkrol tshul bsdus pa de'i sgo nas bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas rdor sems kyi nga rgyal gyis bum bskyed dang bsgrubs na bde zhing 'thad par mthong ste/ da lta'i phyag len ltar bum bskyed la 'gal ba mi 'dug kyang bdag bskyed ma bsdus par mjug gi bar du rang dgar bzhag pa 'di cung mi bde bar sems so/ /de bzhin du bum bskyed kyi mjug de ma thag bum lha'i ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa 'od zhu byas na legs par 'dir gzhung kha cig tu bshad 'dug pa ltar 'thad par go nas/ de'i rgyu mtshan logs su bris yod pas 'dod na blta'o/

/de ltar brjod pa 'di dag kha cig gi yid du mi 'bab kyang rang gi bsam tshod tsam smras pa yin pas bzod par gsol lo/ / zhes pa 'di ni yang shākya'i dge slob gshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba ste gnas brtan sbyin pa blo bzang gis par du bsgrubs pa'i tshe yi ge ba ni skyid phug sgang ba'o/ /dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul bzhugs/ - PAGE 236-- PAGE 237-- PAGE 232-
